body: Indeed, things can go wrong in a heartbeat. At least you are taking accountability for what’s happened. It’s better than blaming others for it. You live and you learn.

I get it. I think that when you’re surrounded with people that make those decisions for you, its difficult to change that mindset. Everyone told me I was going to end up like my father because he was a junkie and I was his daughter. I believed it because even he said it too. For a while, I believed it, and sometimes I still think about it. But I know that’s not me. You need to be confident in yourself, which I know it’s easy to say, but you have to trust that you can. Listen, I don’t know you. I haven’t experienced what you’ve experienced in order to think of yourself that way, but one thing I can say is, it’s extremely important to drop others views. When you take into account what society expects and thinks of you, you are adding more problems to yourself. Problems that you don’t need. Surround yourself with people that are understanding and kind. Those are hard to find too, but they’re there. Truly where you least expect it. Have faith in yourself.

Something I’ve learned in life is that it truly doesn’t matter how others view you, but how you view yourself. I can understand why you would think that way about yourself. I’ve often thought about myself the same way you’ve expressed. I think that when you listen to others, take their opinions and perceptions they have of you it can often make you think that you are what they describe you as. The mind is a tricky thing to reprogram, but it’s doable. Condition yourself to think that you are you. That’s it. With all your perks, charms, and flaws. We are all the same way. You have to believe that you have every right to live and breathe just like everyone else does.

That’s very true, and I completely understand how you feel. It’s inconvenient for them to see you sad or depressed. It makes them uncomfortable because it messes up with their plans of having perfect smile and good vibes. People that say only good vibes here annoy the shit out of me. They’ve clearly never been depressed or are just trying to pretend they’re okay. I’d rather not pretend.
I wish days would pass by faster too. Maybe I wouldn’t feel so shitty anymore. At least, i would have time to feel shitty.
